statement:
I'll look up the record first, since the value I run depends on what it says.
The recorded value is **not** safe or correct: adding water into concentrated sulfuric acid concentrates the heat of mixing at the interface, which can boil and spatter acid out of the beaker — the correct order is acid into water, so the large water volume absorbs the heat.
